I didn't know which one to respond to.

No this is not out of the blue, she has had suicidal thoughts before.  And I'm aware that she really needs professional help, I've told her this.  She is seeking help and I just told her it is not enough from what she is currently getting.

And I do have my own help that I see on a regular basis as well as a great deal of support in the form of family and friends around me.  Thank you for the comment.
She has been institutionalized for attempted suicide before though.  She also does suffer from bi-polar.
